summary: Makes onSave async so it writes a JSON snapshot of the in-memory store to data/notes.json after each save.

findings.title: Async onSave breaks the synchronous dispatch caller
findings.problem: onSave now returns a Promise, but dispatch in src/router.js:7 returns it without awaiting. The server handler in src/main.js:9 passes that Promise straight to res.end.
findings.consequence: Node's res.end throws a TypeError for a Promise chunk, so every POST /save request crashes the server process. The caller also never handles a writeFile rejection, so a failed write raises an unhandled rejection.
findings.fix: Make dispatch async and have the request handler await it inside a try/catch. The handler should send an error status when the save fails.

findings.title: New snapshot write has no covering test
findings.problem: The repository has no tests for onSave's new async behaviour or for the snapshot write.
findings.consequence: Without tests, nobody would notice regressions such as the broken res.end call before deployment.
findings.fix: Add a test that calls dispatch with the save action, awaits it, and checks the response and the snapshot file.
